headline: FURY GOLD INTERSECTS 14.95 G/T OVER 4.25 METRES AT EAU CLAIRE — High-Grade Zone Extends 60 Metres Up-Dip at James Bay, Quebec
snippet: Fury Gold Mines (TSX-V: FURY) reported hole 26EC-131 grading 14.95 g/t gold over 4.25 metres true width at Eau Claire in James Bay, Quebec — extending high-grade mineralization 60 metres up-dip from prior intercepts. Results are now available for 26 holes totalling 13,374 metres from the 2026 program, with additional assays pending.

headline: AVINO DRILLS 554 G/T SILVER OVER 2.76 METRES AT LA PRECIOSA — 750 G/T Peak Grade Hits in First 2026 Phase, Durango Mexico
snippet: Avino Silver & Gold Mines (TSX: ASM) released first-phase 2026 drill results at La Preciosa, Durango, Mexico: hole PMLP-26-20 returned 554 g/t silver over 2.76 metres true width, including a peak interval of 750 g/t over 1.46 metres. Thirteen holes were completed in the phase, with the mineralised zone now extending beyond previous limits.

headline: GOLD FACES PRE-NOVEMBER 3 SELL-OFF RISK — Trump Midterm Strategy Comes Into Focus, Precious Metals Traders On Alert
snippet: A GoldSeek analyst argues gold faces elevated selling pressure in the days before the November 3 U.S. midterm elections as the Trump administration's strategy creates near-term headwinds. The piece outlines specific price levels traders are watching and tactical positioning considerations for precious metals investors heading into the vote.

headline: GOLD MINERS' Q2'26 FUNDAMENTALS: Near-Record Profits, Decade-Low Valuations — Hamilton Says Sector Gap Is Closing
snippet: Adam Hamilton's quarterly fundamentals review at GoldSeek finds major gold miners delivered near-record profits in Q2 2026 despite bullion's drawdown, yet the sector sits at its lowest valuations in a decade. The GDXJ junior miner ETF holds $9.2 billion in net assets but has sharply underperformed bullion — a spread Hamilton says is historically mean-reverting.

headline: SPROTT: GOLD MINERS AT 5.7x EV/EBITDA — 22% Below 20-Year Average Despite Forward EPS Rising 4x Since 2023
snippet: Sprott Asset Management's Kenny Zhu told investors the NYSE Arca Gold Miners Index traded at just 5.7 times expected operating earnings at September 30 — roughly 22% below its 20-year average — even as forward EPS has risen more than four times since end-2023. Net debt across major producers has fallen to a 20-year low while shareholder distributions continue to rise.

headline: FIRST QUANTUM PURSUES RIGI TAX BREAKS FOR $5.3B TACA TACA — Argentina Incentive Could Reshape Copper Project Economics
snippet: First Quantum Minerals is preparing its application for Argentina's RIGI investment incentive framework for the $5.3 billion Taca Taca copper project in Salta Province. RIGI approval would substantially reduce the effective tax rate on the project, which has faced prolonged development delays due to Argentina's fiscal complexity.

headline: ONYX GOLD EXTENDS ARGUS SYSTEM TO 2.6 KILOMETRES — 166.0 Metres at 0.7 G/T at Argus Main, Munro-Croesus, Ontario
snippet: Onyx Gold Corp (TSX-V: ONYX) reported a 166.0-metre intercept grading 0.7 g/t gold at Argus Main at the Munro-Croesus Project in Ontario, extending the Argus gold system to approximately 2.6 kilometres of strike length. Mineralisation remains open along strike and at depth, building the case for a bulk-tonnage open-pit scenario near Timmins.

headline: KINGFISHER METALS WRAPS 2026 SEASON AT GOLDEN TRIANGLE — 13,551 Metres in 24 Holes at HWY 37, Scale-Up to 20,000m Planned for 2027
snippet: Kingfisher Metals (TSX-V: KFR) completed its 2026 drill program at the HWY 37 property in British Columbia's Golden Triangle, totalling 13,551 metres across 24 new holes. The company is planning a significant scale-up to approximately 20,000 metres for the 2027 season as results from the current program are incorporated into future targeting.

headline: SLAM EXPLORATION HITS NEW DISCOVERY AT GOODWIN — 1.53% Copper-Equivalent Over 14.45 Core Metres Opens Third Target Zone
snippet: SLAM Exploration (TSX-V: SXL) completed its Goodwin drill program with a new copper-gold-silver discovery grading 1.53% copper equivalent over 14.45 core metres, opening a third target zone at the project. Results for 213 samples remain pending, with additional assays expected to define the strike and depth extent of the new zone.

headline: 45% OF CENTRAL BANKS PLAN TO BUY MORE GOLD — WGC Survey Hits Highest Bullish Reading Since 2018
snippet: The World Gold Council's 2026 Central Bank Gold Reserves Survey found 45% of respondents plan to increase their gold holdings within a year — the highest share since 2018 — while only one institution plans to reduce reserves. China added its most gold in a single month since 2023 in September (23 tonnes), and the survey highlights sustained structural diversification away from the U.S. dollar.
